candidate.environment_method: Hard-link clone of the validated .venv; new packages are added only to the clone. Invoke the clone's own interpreter, never its cloned pip script: '<venv>/bin/python -m pip install --no-deps ...'. A cloned pip script retains the original venv's shebang and silently installs into the validated environment.
candidate.reason_for_no_deps: Preserve the separately installed torch 2.10.0+xpu and triton-xpu 3.6.0 stack; inspect and install any missing pure-Python requirements explicitly.
candidate.causal_conv1d: not selected: upstream package is CUDA-only; retain the PyTorch fallback

import_gate.detail: transformers hook resolution verified: chunk_gated_delta_rule and fused_recurrent_gated_delta_rule dispatch to FLA; both causal-conv1d hooks remain PyTorch fallbacks.
import_gate.device_selector_requirement: FLA imports abort (C++ sycl::exception, SIGABRT) under a Level-Zero-only ONEAPI_DEVICE_SELECTOR because triton-xpu 3.6.0 driver.c init_devices probes for the OpenCL-backend twin device, which a level_zero-only filter excludes. Adding the matching opencl entry keeps torch.xpu.device_count()==1 with the A770 visible while satisfying the probe. Always confirm the device name is A770 after reboot; indices can change.
import_gate.torch_note: importing fla prints a Python-below-3.11-recommended warning; informational only.
